research.searchCoverage: Official Gumroad API v2, access-token authentication, company identity, and dated security coverage reviewed on 2026-09-13. The 2025 coordinated Hacktron pentest and remediation are recorded; no current unresolved customer-account compromise was identified. This is not a breach-free claim.

Official Gumroad API v2 endpoints, access-token query/form examples, international product identity, and dated security coverage reviewed on 2026-09-13. Historical disclosed vulnerabilities with published remediation are recorded. This is not a breach-free claim.

incidents.summary: Coordinated white-box assessment reported SQL injection and XSS findings in the Gumroad application.
incidents.remediation: Hacktron recorded that Gumroad triaged and fixed the issues, including verified fixes for the reported SQL injection and XSS findings.
incidents.limitation: Historical disclosed application vulnerabilities, not evidence of a current unresolved customer-account compromise; live authentication unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck uses documented GET /v2/user.

Pinned executor and official gumroad.com/api curl examples send access_token as a GET query parameter. Newer help copy prefers Authorization Bearer; native auth follows the still-documented query placement the pinned source implements.

Gumroad can answer HTTP 200 with {success:false, message:...}. Native bodyErrorPaths cannot invert a success boolean (true is treated as an error), so a non-empty top-level message is the documented error signal.
Returns raw Gumroad JSON under data. Product create/update/delete is omitted.
Product ID is URI-encoded.
Creates a product via POST /v2/products using form-encoded name and price fields from the public API.
Updates a product via PUT /v2/products/:id with optional name, price, and description.
Deletes a product via DELETE /v2/products/:id.
Publishes a product via PUT /v2/products/:id/enable.
Unpublishes a product via PUT /v2/products/:id/disable.
Optional after, before, product_id, email and page_key filters are caller controlled. next_page_url/next_page_key are returned as metadata and are never followed.
Refund, ship, and receipt-resend writes are omitted.
Sale ID is URI-encoded.
Marks a sale shipped via PUT /v2/sales/:id/mark_as_shipped.
Refunds a sale via PUT /v2/sales/:id/refund with optional amount_cents.
Lists subscribers via GET /v2/products/:id/subscribers.
Gets a subscriber via GET /v2/subscribers/:id.
Lists offer codes via GET /v2/products/:id/offer_codes.
Creates an offer code via POST /v2/products/:id/offer_codes.
Deletes an offer code via DELETE /v2/products/:id/offer_codes/:id.
Verifies a license via POST /v2/licenses/verify.
Enables a license via PUT /v2/licenses/enable.
Disables a license via PUT /v2/licenses/disable.
Lists resource subscriptions via GET /v2/resource_subscriptions?resource_name=.
Creates a resource subscription via PUT /v2/resource_subscriptions.
EventOnly webhook for Gumroad sale resource subscription pings. No outbound HTTP.
EventOnly webhook for Gumroad refund resource subscription pings. No outbound HTTP.
EventOnly webhook for Gumroad cancellation resource subscription pings. No outbound HTTP.
EventOnly webhook for Gumroad subscription_updated pings. No outbound HTTP.
EventOnly webhook for Gumroad subscription_ended pings. No outbound HTTP.
EventOnly webhook for Gumroad subscription_restarted pings. No outbound HTTP.
